mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% and is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a contraction in the real economy, which triggers a flight to quality and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 0.5% signals robust labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the PAYEMS growth signal in this regime is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past month indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS has increased, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) decline by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS declines by >0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE has risen, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 and is declining, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 105.0 and declining, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
